name: Burger Seller Agent 2
description: Specialized seller agent 2 for browsing burger menus, checking pricing, and placing orders.

skills.name: get_burger_menu
skills.description: Retrieves the full menu of available burgers and their prices in IDR.

skills.name: create_burger_order

examples: I would like to order 2 Double Cheeseburgers
